## [Overview](https://trust.cast.ai/?itemName=overview&source=click)

At CAST AI, trust is the foundation of every customer relationship. Our platform automates and optimizes Kubernetes for engineering teams around the world, and we hold the way we protect your data to the same standard we hold our product.

This Trust Center lets you self-serve documentation about our security, privacy and compliance posture. After a quick access request and NDA, you can view:

- **Audit reports and certifications**, including our ISO/IEC 27001:2022 certificate, SOC 2 Type 2 report and PCI DSS Attestation of Compliance.
- **Penetration test reports** from independent third-party testing of the CAST AI console, API and cloud infrastructure.
- **Internal policies** covering information security, access control, encryption, incident response, business continuity and vendor management.

Our subprocessors, legal terms, AI practices and live service status are public, with no request needed. Browse our **Frequently Asked Questions** for quick answers, and for technical product information, including permissions and data collection, visit [CAST AI Docs](https://docs.cast.ai/).
